Aegis.name: Aegis
Aegis.description: This weapon can't cause Critical Injuries, can't ablate armor, and if it would reduce a target to under 1 HP it instead leaves them Unconscious on 1 HP.

Arasaka Minami 10 P/M/S.name: Arasaka Minami 10 P/M/S
Arasaka Minami 10 P/M/S.description: A concealable SMG. +1 to Attack. Equipped with a Silencer.

Arasaka Origami.name: Arasaka Origami
Arasaka Origami.description:
A concealable folding bow, reloaded as part of an Attack Action.

Foilding/Unfolding does not require an Action

Arasaka WSS Sniper System.name: Arasaka WSS Sniper System
Arasaka WSS Sniper System.description: A long-distance sniper rifle. Holds 4 bullets in a magazine. +1 to Attack.

Archimedes.name: Archimedes
Archimedes.description: Uses the Pilot Air Vehicle Skill instead of the Heavy Weapons Skill to fire, requires the has Targeting Scope Cyberware, and can only use Smart Rockets. It does come with one Smart Rocket included however. How nice.

ARS-5 Submachine Gun.name: ARS-5 Submachine Gun
ARS-5 Submachine Gun.description:
This heavy SMG is the complete package; it comes with a Smartgun Link, Infrared Nightvision Scope, and a Sniping Scope*.

*All three must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Ballistic Harpoon.name: Ballistic Harpoon
Ballistic Harpoon.description: A very heavy exotic melee weapon that may also be launched as a ranged weapon as if it were a crossbow.

Big Dreem.name: Big Dreem
Big Dreem.description: Exotic SMG. Autofire only. Even if you drop the weapon, it will continue to Autofire.

Burst Flamethrower.name: Burst Flamethrower
Burst Flamethrower.description:
Can only fire Incendiary Shotgun Shells, but targets ignited by this weapon burn for 4HP a turn.

Additionally, this weapon can consume all it's remaining ammo to shoot a fireball, which explodes in a similar fashion to an incendiary grenade. The user of the weapon is also consumed by the fireball, getting Deadly on Fire*.

*Special fire mode not currently supported; will need to be manually applied

Captain Cuddlefish Ultra Snag-Em.name: Captain Cuddlefish Ultra Snag-Em
Captain Cuddlefish Ultra Snag-Em.description:
Exotic Light Melee Weapon Buy and equip collectible outfits for your Captain Cuddlefish! (Sold separately.)

Able to make melee attacks up to 10 m/yds away. Grants a +2 bonus to aimed shots against held items when using this weapon.

Chadran Arms City Reaper.name: Chadran Arms City Reaper
Chadran Arms City Reaper.description: A heavy SMG. Due to its size it can't be concealed. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Chadran Arms Jungle Reaper.name: Chadran Arms Jungle Reaper
Chadran Arms Jungle Reaper.description: A poor quality assault rifle. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Chainknife.name: Chainknife
Chainknife.description:
Takes an action to rev up, but once revved is a powerful melee weapon. When not revved deals 2d6 damage*.

*Not revved mode not currently supported, so will need to manually reduce damage

Crusher.name: Crusher
Crusher.description: A pistol that fires shotgun shells. What's not to love.

Dai Lung Cybermag 20.name: Dai Lung Cybermag 20
Dai Lung Cybermag 20.description: A concealable SMG. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear. Equipped with a Drum Magazine.

Dai Lung Magnum.name: Dai Lung Magnum
Dai Lung Magnum.description: A concealable, heavy pistol. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Dai Lung Streetmaster.name: Dai Lung Streetmaster
Dai Lung Streetmaster.description: A concealable, medium-sized pistol. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Darra Polytechnic Binary.name: Darra Polytechnic Binary
Darra Polytechnic Binary.description: A standard-issue assault rifle. Equipped with Grenade Launcher Underbarrel.

Dragon Flamethrower.name: Dragon Flamethrower
Dragon Flamethrower.description: Fire at your finger tips. Can only fire Incendiary Shotgun Shells, but targets ignited by this weapon burn for 4HP a turn.

Eagletech Arbelest.name: Eagletech Arbelest
Eagletech Arbelest.description:
An excellent quality crossbow equipped with a Smartgun Link, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

+1 to Attack check.

Eagletech Bearcat.name: Eagletech Bearcat
Eagletech Bearcat.description: An excellent quality recurve bow , reloaded as part of an Attack action. +1 to Attack check.

Eagletech Scorpion.name: Eagletech Scorpion
Eagletech Scorpion.description:
A sleek crossbow branded with the Eagletech logo, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

+1 to Attack check.

Eagletech Stryker.name: Eagletech Stryker
Eagletech Stryker.description: A crossbow branded with the Eagletech logo, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

Eagletech Tigercat.name: Eagletech Tigercat
Eagletech Tigercat.description:
A compound bow equipped with a Smart Link, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

+1 to Attack check.

Eagletech Tomcat.name: Eagletech Tomcat
Eagletech Tomcat.description: A revitalized bow branded with the Eagletech logo, reloaded as part of an Attack Action.

Enviro-launcher.name: Enviro-launcher
Enviro-launcher.description: This specially engineered rocket launcher is only capable of being fired once. However, once it has been fired the user can use an action to break of a vial attached to the launcher, which will release an enzyme that will destroy the launcher totally within an hour.

EVW Mountaineer.name: EVW Mountaineer
EVW Mountaineer.description: A hunting crossbow equipped with an underbarrel grapple gun, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

Faisal's Convenice (Armor-Piercing).name: Faisal's Convenice (Armor-Piercing)
Faisal's Convenice (Armor-Piercing).description: A single use disposable very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed or reloaded.

Faisal's Convenice (Basic).name: Faisal's Convenice (Basic)
Faisal's Convenice (Basic).description: A single use disposable very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed or reloaded.

Faisal's Convenice (Expansive).name: Faisal's Convenice (Expansive)
Faisal's Convenice (Expansive).description: A single use disposable very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed or reloaded.

Faisal's Convenice (Incendiary).name: Faisal's Convenice (Incendiary)
Faisal's Convenice (Incendiary).description: A single use disposable very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed or reloaded.

Faisal's Convenice (Rubber).name: Faisal's Convenice (Rubber)
Faisal's Convenice (Rubber).description: A single use disposable very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed or reloaded.

Faisal's Escape Plan.name: Faisal's Escape Plan
Faisal's Escape Plan.description:
A concealable, medium-sized pistol. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Can be thrown as if it were a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.7xhKxgwOELzaPyYr]{Smoke Grenade}. When thrown, any installed attatchments and loaded ammunition are Destroyed Beyond Repair.

Faisal's OnlyChance (Armor-Piercing).name: Faisal's OnlyChance (Armor-Piercing)
Faisal's OnlyChance (Armor-Piercing).description: A disposable shotgun that cannot be reloaded. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Faisal's OnlyChance (Basic).name: Faisal's OnlyChance (Basic)
Faisal's OnlyChance (Basic).description: A disposable shotgun that cannot be reloaded. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Faisal's OnlyChance (Expansive).name: Faisal's OnlyChance (Expansive)
Faisal's OnlyChance (Expansive).description: A disposable shotgun that cannot be reloaded. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Faisal's OnlyChance (Incendiary).name: Faisal's OnlyChance (Incendiary)
Faisal's OnlyChance (Incendiary).description: A disposable shotgun that cannot be reloaded. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Faisal's OnlyChance (Rubber).name: Faisal's OnlyChance (Rubber)
Faisal's OnlyChance (Rubber).description: A disposable shotgun that cannot be reloaded. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Federated Arms Super Chief Plus.name: Federated Arms Super Chief Plus
Federated Arms Super Chief Plus.description: A very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Federated Arms Tech-Assault III.name: Federated Arms Tech-Assault III
Federated Arms Tech-Assault III.description: A concealable SMG. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Fire Extinguisher.name: Fire Extinguisher
Fire Extinguisher.description:
A two-handed exotic very heavy pistol that extinguishes burning objects and edgerunners.

Maximum Range 6m/yds, roll combat damage only when fighting fires.

Flare Gun.name: Flare Gun
Flare Gun.description:
As well as normal Grenade Ammunition, this weapon can fire road flares*. They don't deal any damage, but if fired into the air can be seen from 3 miles. You cannot install this weapon in Pop-up Cyberware.

*Currently not supported so will need to manually delete a road flare from actors inventory after firing

GunMart Hawk's Eye.name: GunMart Hawk's Eye
GunMart Hawk's Eye.description:
A concealable poor quality folding bow, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the weapon jams and requires using an action to clear.

GunMart Home Defender.name: GunMart Home Defender
GunMart Home Defender.description: An all-purpose shotgun. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

GunMart Hunter.name: GunMart Hunter
GunMart Hunter.description:
A poor quality crossbow branded with the GunMart logo, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the weapon jams and requires using an action to clear.

GunMart Midnight Defender.name: GunMart Midnight Defender
GunMart Midnight Defender.description: A concealable, heavy pistol. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear. Comes with an integrated IR/Nightvision Scope.

GunMart Midnight Hunter.name: GunMart Midnight Hunter
GunMart Midnight Hunter.description:
A poor quality crossbow equipped with a night vision scope, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the weapon jams and requires using an action to clear.

GunMart Porta-Morta.name: GunMart Porta-Morta
GunMart Porta-Morta.description: A poor quality grenade launcher equipped with a drum magazine. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

GunMart Sherwood.name: GunMart Sherwood
GunMart Sherwood.description:
A poor quality bow branded with the GunMart logo, reloaded as part of an Attack action.

If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the weapon jams and requires using an action to clear.

GunMart Snipe-Starr.name: GunMart Snipe-Starr
GunMart Snipe-Starr.description: A long-distance sniper rifle. Holds 4 bullets in a magazine. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Hellbringer.name: Hellbringer
Hellbringer.description: When this things shoots, you know about it. If fired by someone with less than 10 BODY, this pistol jams. An action is required to unjam it.

Hello Cutie 1TruLuv.name: Hello Cutie 1TruLuv
Hello Cutie 1TruLuv.description:
Exotic Sniper Rifle. Can load non basic ammunition.

Equipped with a Sniping Scope and Infrared Night Vision Scope*, and built-in Agent which includes a pseudo AI girlfriend who can recognize and talk to the owner.

Take good care of it/her and use it/her regularly and the weapon improves. Neglect it/her and you'll have to apologize...

* These upgrades need to be installed manually after adding to an actor

Hello Cutie Fisher Kitty.name: Hello Cutie Fisher Kitty
Hello Cutie Fisher Kitty.description:
Exotic Heavy Pistol (50m/yd Max Range) Fires mini-harpoons that cannot cause critcal injuries. Each mini-harpoon sticks to its target regardless of damage dealt, and removing a mini-harpoon takes 1 Action. All retractable mini-harpoons are dislodged and recovered when using an action to reloading the weapon.

The user may use an action to electrify the cables connected to each mini-harpoon and deal [[/r 2d6#Electric Damage (Ignores Armor)]] damage directly to any connected target's HP. If a target is connected by 3 or more mini-harpoons they take [[/r 3d6#Electric Damage (Ignores Armor)]] damage instead.

Hello Cutie Gun-Gun Friend-Friend.name: Hello Cutie Gun-Gun Friend-Friend
Hello Cutie Gun-Gun Friend-Friend.description:
Excellent Quality Assault Rifle that can conceal another one-handed gun inside Gun-Gun Friend-Friend's frame as an action*. Contains two available upgrade slots that do not affect the concealed weapon.

*Currently unsupported, make a note on any weapon you "install" into this gun.

Hello Cutie Happy Dancer.name: Hello Cutie Happy Dancer
Hello Cutie Happy Dancer.description: A heavy SMG. Due to its size it can't be concealed. +1 to Attack.

Hello Cutie Hidden Cougar.name: Hello Cutie Hidden Cougar
Hello Cutie Hidden Cougar.description: A concealable heavy SMG. +1 to Attack. Incompatible with any magazine upgrades.

Hello Cutie Hypurr-Hammer.name: Hello Cutie Hypurr-Hammer
Hello Cutie Hypurr-Hammer.description:
Two-Handed Very Heavy Melee Weapon requires BODY 9 or higher to wield effectively. Comes in 4 styles: Bengal, Egyptian Mau, Sphinx, and Ussuri.

  • Does not halve SP like normal melee weapons.

  • User rolls twice and chooses the outcome when determining critical injuries.

  • Users with Body 8 or less deal 1d6 less damage.

Hello Cutie Janus Hex.name: Hello Cutie Janus Hex
Hello Cutie Janus Hex.description:
Excellent Quality Very Heavy Pistol that shoots proprietary Scent Balls. Incompatible with all magazine upgrades.

Targets with meat eyes must suffer -3 penalty to ranged attack and perception checks unless they succeed a DV 15 Resist Drugs/Torture check, in which case the penalty is reduced by 2.

Hello Cutie Modball Gun.name: Hello Cutie Modball Gun
Hello Cutie Modball Gun.description:
Medium Pistol that shoots ModBalls. Incompatible with magazine upgrades.

ModBall ammo can be purchased or created with a ModBall Construction Kit.

Hello Cutie My Friend The Ocelot.name: Hello Cutie My Friend The Ocelot
Hello Cutie My Friend The Ocelot.description:
Excellent Quality Shotgun that has an alternate SMG style auto fire mode*.

Uses only Shotgun Slug Ammunition, cannot install magazine upgrades.

*Alternate weapon fire modes are currently not supported.

Hello Cutie Thundercat Bat.name: Hello Cutie Thundercat Bat
Hello Cutie Thundercat Bat.description:
Excellent Quality Exotic Two-handed Medium Melee Weapon Comes with an integrated speaker that plays beloved baseball sound effects.

  • Both user and target suffer the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-head.Item.qRkCxq0KTuBnw2wj]{Damaged Ear} critical injury if they fail a DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs Check.

  • Target is knocked unconscious if damage dealt would reduce them to under 1 HP. Doesn't cause Critical Injuries or ablate armor.

IMI UZ 2045 Pro.name: IMI UZ 2045 Pro
IMI UZ 2045 Pro.description: A heavy SMG. Due to its size it can't be concealed. Equipped with a Smartgun Link.

Kodiak Hunter.name: Kodiak Hunter
Kodiak Hunter.description:
A long-distance hunting rifle. +1 to Attack.

An action is required to eject the spent round each time the rifle is fired.

MetaCorp Hela Smart Launcher.name: MetaCorp Hela Smart Launcher
MetaCorp Hela Smart Launcher.description: Bring out the big guns. This smartgun link equipped rocket launcher will do some damage.

MicroCutie by HelloCutie.name: MicroCutie by HelloCutie
MicroCutie by HelloCutie.description:
An excellent quality pistol with a unique Hypurrburst™ mode fire mode*. The weapon purrs when used. Hypurrburst™ is disabled if less than 4 bullets are in the clip.

When in Hypurrburst™ mode, the following applies

  • MicroCutie is ROF 1
  • Purrs audibly
  • Fires a single shot, drains clip, and does 4d6 damage
  • Cannot be used to make aimed shots

*Special fire mode not currently supported; will need to be manually applied

Militech Boomer Buster.name: Militech Boomer Buster
Militech Boomer Buster.description: A very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed. +1 to Attack.

Militech Dragon.name: Militech Dragon
Militech Dragon.description: An excellent quality assault rifle. +1 to Attack.

Militech Hotshot L-ATGM.name: Militech Hotshot L-ATGM
Militech Hotshot L-ATGM.description: Bring out the big guns. This rocket launcher will do some damage. +1 to Attack.

Militech Hotshot L-ATGM-N.name: Militech Hotshot L-ATGM-N
Militech Hotshot L-ATGM-N.description: Bring out the big guns. Equipped with an IR/Nightvision scope, this rocket launcher will do some damage. +1 to Attack.

Militech Mini-Grenade.name: Militech Mini-Grenade
Militech Mini-Grenade.description: A high-impact grenade launcher. You can use a variety of grenades with this.

Militech Ninja Sniper.name: Militech Ninja Sniper
Militech Ninja Sniper.description: A long-distance sniper rifle equipped with a silencer. Holds 4 bullets in a magazine.

Militech Ronin Hyperlight Assualt.name: Militech Ronin Hyperlight Assualt
Militech Ronin Hyperlight Assualt.description: An excellent quality light assault rifle. +1 to Attack. Equipped with an Extended Magazine.

Militech Sherriff.name: Militech Sherriff
Militech Sherriff.description: A concealable, heavy pistol. +1 to Attack. Incompatible with magazine upgrades.

Militech Urban.name: Militech Urban
Militech Urban.description: Bring out the big guns. This rocket launcher will do some damage.

Militech Viper.name: Militech Viper
Militech Viper.description: A heavy SMG. Due to its size it can't be concealed. +1 to Attack.

Multiple Ammunition Pistol.name: Multiple Ammunition Pistol
Multiple Ammunition Pistol.description:
A very heavy pistol capable of loading up to five different ammo types at once*, with the user able to pick between them before firing.

*Currently not supported, so users have to manually change ammo types

Mustang Arms Deathstalker.name: Mustang Arms Deathstalker
Mustang Arms Deathstalker.description: An all-purpose shotgun. Equipped with an Airhypo Bayonet.

Mustang Arms Mark II.name: Mustang Arms Mark II
Mustang Arms Mark II.description: A concealable, heavy pistol. +1 to Attack. Equipped with an Extended Magazine.

Mustang Arms Rodeo.name: Mustang Arms Rodeo
Mustang Arms Rodeo.description:
A concealable SMG. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

User must make a DV15 Handgun check when making an autofire attack or the damage multiplier cannot exceed x2.

M-02 Heavy Rifle.name: M-02 Heavy Rifle
M-02 Heavy Rifle.description: This weapon fires it's own custom ammunition, priced at 500eb (Expensive) for 80 rounds of Armor-Piercing ammo.

M-95A4 Assault Weapon.name: M-95A4 Assault Weapon
M-95A4 Assault Weapon.description: An excellent quality assault rifle equipped with a Drum Magazine & Sniping Scope.

Nomad .357 Magnum.name: Nomad .357 Magnum
Nomad .357 Magnum.description: A concealable, medium-sized pistol with an extended magazine.

Nomad Air Cannon.name: Nomad Air Cannon
Nomad Air Cannon.description: Rather than normal shotgun ammunition, this weapon fires whatever liquid is placed into it. Acid can be bought for 10eb (Cheap) that reduces all armour worn by the target by 1 SP. Poison or Biotoxin can also be loaded, though requires 3 vials per shot.

Nomad Big Gulp.name: Nomad Big Gulp
Nomad Big Gulp.description: A very heavy double-barreled pistol. It can't be concealed. +1 to Attack. Incompatible with all magazine upgrades.

Nomad Long Rifle.name: Nomad Long Rifle
Nomad Long Rifle.description: A long-distance sniper rifle, commonly used by nomads. Holds 4 bullets in a magazine.

Nomad Pneumatic Bolt Gun.name: Nomad Pneumatic Bolt Gun
Nomad Pneumatic Bolt Gun.description: Capable of firing all Non-Basic ammunition, this weapon is still as versatile as when it was invented over two decades ago.

Nova Model 757 Cityhunter.name: Nova Model 757 Cityhunter
Nova Model 757 Cityhunter.description:
This pistol fires it's own custom rounds bought in packs of 18, though they cost the same as a pack of 10. Comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Pocket Launcher.name: Pocket Launcher
Pocket Launcher.description: While unloaded, this weapon can be concealed.

SDF-45.name: SDF-45
SDF-45.description: This rocket launcher can only load Armor-Piercing rockets, and has a maximum range of 400 m/yds. When fired one rocket at a time, the GM chooses where they rockets land. When fired two rockets at a time, the GM chooses where the rockets land but this time up to 50 m/yds away from the target, and with each rocket more than 10 m/yds from each other.

SlamDance ElectroMag.name: SlamDance ElectroMag
SlamDance ElectroMag.description:
An electromagnetic shotgun that shoots proprietary rounds.

@UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.dlc_ammo.Item.LjJChw12H7TJSkm5]{ElectroMag (Basic-Shell)} @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.dlc_ammo.Item.BhtcF9fMOrI5tsQE]{ElectroMag (Incendiary-Shell)} @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.dlc_ammo.Item.CCEXsWo665wo7cD3]{ElectroMag (Basic-Slug)} @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.dlc_ammo.Item.F3uxV0pSScgCgKat]{ElectroMag (Incendiary-Slug)}

User may switch proprietary ammo between Slug or Shell each time they fire the weapon. (Alternate Fire-Modes are not currently supported.)

SportMaster.name: SportMaster
SportMaster.description: A sport rifle, for fun, not people. Can only load Small Game Ammunition and is incapable of Autofire and Suppressive Fire.

Sternmeyer P-35.name: Sternmeyer P-35
Sternmeyer P-35.description: A very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed.

Sternmeyer P-35 Covert.name: Sternmeyer P-35 Covert
Sternmeyer P-35 Covert.description: A very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed. Equipped with a Silencer.

Sternmeyer SMG-21.name: Sternmeyer SMG-21
Sternmeyer SMG-21.description: A heavy SMG. Due to its size it can't be concealed.

ST-5 Assault Rifle.name: ST-5 Assault Rifle
ST-5 Assault Rifle.description: A - relatively - reliable gun. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) you must then toss a coin; if you win the gun fires as normal, while if you lose the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Sub-Flechette Gun.name: Sub-Flechette Gun
Sub-Flechette Gun.description:
This SMG can only fire it's own custom Armor-Piercing Ammunition, however that ammo ablates by 4 when dealing damage. Comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

SurvivalMaster.name: SurvivalMaster
SurvivalMaster.description: Exotic Assault Rifle, no Autofire, no Suppressive Fire.

Tactical Umbrella.name: Tactical Umbrella
Tactical Umbrella.description:
A stylish umbrella with pop-out weapons. Contains a Poor Quality Exotic Heavy Pistol (2 bullet capacity).

Multiple Weapon Modes: Tactical Umbrella also contains an Excellent Quality Exotic Heavy Melee Weapon.

Provides the protection of a normal umbrella (NCW pg 6)

TearJerker.name: TearJerker
TearJerker.description: This weapon can only fire Smoke or Teargas Ammunition.

Teen Dreem.name: Teen Dreem
Teen Dreem.description: This SMG can use Autofire and Suppressive Fire all the way down to it's last 2 bullets. Caution is required however, as using either firing mode well melt the gun beyond repair.

Timeless WW1 Rifle to Pistol Conversion.name: Timeless WW1 Rifle to Pistol Conversion
Timeless WW1 Rifle to Pistol Conversion.description:
Poor Quality Very Heavy Pistol.

Manual rearming of the bolt between each shot (one Action).

Towa Manufacturing Type-G.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-G
Towa Manufacturing Type-G.description: A high-impact grenade launcher. You can use a variety of grenades with this. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Towa Manufacturing Type-R.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-R
Towa Manufacturing Type-R.description: Bring out the big guns. This rocket launcher will do some damage. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Towa Manufacturing Type-R*2.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-R*2
Towa Manufacturing Type-R*2.description:
Bring out the big guns. This double-barrel rocket launcher will do some damage.

Reloading this weapon takes 2 actions.

Towa Type-00-Kai.name: Towa Type-00-Kai
Towa Type-00-Kai.description: An excellent quality sniper rifle equipped with a Smart Link. +1 to Attack.

Triple Threat.name: Triple Threat
Triple Threat.description:
Comes with an Exotic Grenade Launcher Underbarrel* which - as the main gun is poor quality - functions as a poor quality weapon. It can't be removed. Both that and the main weapon can fire non-Basic Ammunition.

*Must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Tsunami Arms Type-18.name: Tsunami Arms Type-18
Tsunami Arms Type-18.description: A high-impact grenade launcher. You can use a variety of grenades with this. +1 to Attack.

Tsunami Arms Type-18-S.name: Tsunami Arms Type-18-S
Tsunami Arms Type-18-S.description: A high-impact grenade launcher equipped with Smartgun Link. You can use a variety of grenades with this. +1 to Attack.

Type-12 Police Pistol.name: Type-12 Police Pistol
Type-12 Police Pistol.description: A concealable, medium-sized pistol. +1 to Attack. Comes with integrated Smart Link, but is incompatible with any magazine upgrades.

WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon.name: WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon
WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon.description:
A bullpup rifle in operation for over two decades. Can fire non-basic ammunition and comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon
